name: Mandakini Bhattacharjee

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Mandakini Bhattacherya writes poetry, criticism and translation. Fakir Chand College’s faculty profile uses the spelling Mandakini Bhattacherya and records her work in English teaching. Her publications include the edited anthology The Mixed Fare and, with Jaydeep Sarangi, a translation of Jatin Bala’s A Life Uprooted: A Bengali Dalit Refugee Remembers, published by Sahitya Akademi in 2022.

Her poems in Kabita Live turn small physical things into measures of intimacy and memory. In ‘The Unkindest Cut’, the changing life of a wound becomes a way of thinking about love and forgetting. In ‘Pearldom’, a broken necklace moves from an ornament against the skin to scattered beads gathered and kept: the object holds what the lovers remember.
